Chapter 01 · Warm up

So, what's new?

It's been a while! Let's talk about the little and big things that happened while we were apart.

8 MIN
Let's start here ↗
What was the best thing that happened to you in the last two months?

The conversation recipe

Don't stop at one sentence.

Try to make each answer into a mini-story. Take your time — we're listening.

Chapter 03 · A little game

Two truths. One lie.

Tell three short stories about the last two months. Two are true. One is completely made up. Can your partner guess?

9 MIN
Three stories. One secret.Tell your stories aloud. The other person listens, asks questions and guesses the lie.
0 / 3 TOLD
Chapter 04 · Friendly debate

Pick a side.

There is no correct answer. Choose what you prefer, explain why, and try to change the other person's mind.

12 MIN
WHICH WOULD YOU CHOOSE?

You have one free week. What sounds better?

Choose A or B to begin your argument.
SPEAKING CHALLENGE

Convince me.

Give your opinion, two reasons and an example. Then ask: “What do you think?”

BUT WAIT...
“I don't agree. Isn't your choice a little boring?”
Chapter 05 · Real-life roleplay

Oh no. Now what?

Something has gone wrong on your trip. Stay calm, explain the problem, ask for help and find a solution together.

9 MIN
YOUR ROLE · THE TRAVELLER

Where is my room?

You booked a hotel room, but the receptionist can't find your reservation. It's late and you're tired. Explain what happened and ask for a solution.

YOUR CONVERSATION MISSION

Explain. Ask. Decide.

01

Explain what's wrong.

02

Ask for help politely.

03

Agree on a solution.

IF YOU NEED A PHRASE

“Excuse me, there's a problem with…”

“Could you help me, please?”

READY FOR A TWIST?
First, try to solve the problem. Then add a new detail.
Chapter 06 · You take the lead

Now, you ask me.

This time, you're in charge. Choose a topic, ask a question and listen carefully. Always ask one more question.

6 MIN
YOUR NEXT QUESTION

What's a place you'd love to visit one day?

CHOOSE A TOPIC

You're the interviewer.

YOUR FOLLOW-UP MISSION

Ask: “Why?” or “Why not?”

Chapter 07 · Before we go

One last thing.

You've done a lot of talking today. Finish with one little story about your past — and one wish for your future.

4 MIN
YOUR 60-SECOND STORY

“If I could live one day from the last two months again, I'd choose...”

Just speak. Don't worry about every word being perfect.

A LITTLE REFLECTION

How did speaking English feel today?

Pick the answer that feels right. There's no score today.

Keep talking. Keep discovering.
